item.title: Quantum Computing Explained for People Who Already Understand Software
item.content:encoded: Quantum speedup is structural, not general. It only exists for problems with specific mathematical properties. Shor's algorithm breaks RSA. Grover's gives quadratic speedup on search. Everything else is largely unproven. For developers, almost nothing in a typical stack benefits from quantum today. Cryptography is the one area where the threat is concrete and the migration window is already open, with NIST finalizing post-quantum standards in 2024.
